# Design Handoff: Lead Lab Technology Stack
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

The technology baseline is ready for local feature development and staging verification. Use Laravel with Inertia React, TypeScript, shadcn/ui, PHP, MySQL or MariaDB, Tailwind CSS, private local storage, database-backed search, YouTube embeds, and the existing Apache or Nginx server pattern.

## First Build Items

1. LL-01 (verify supported runtime, database, storage, staging, and deployment method).
2. LL-02 (build the authenticated application shell and navigation).
3. LL-03 (implement invite or administrator-controlled participant access).
4. LL-08 (build session fields for title, category, date, description, video, and materials).
5. LL-09 (implement YouTube video embedding and playback).
6. LL-10 (implement private material storage and authenticated downloads).
7. LL-14 (build member administration, access revocation, and permission management).
8. LL-17 (enforce server-side authorization for routes, APIs, and files).
9. LL-23 (test authentication, roles, access revocation, and direct unauthorized requests).

Local feature development may proceed with SQLite and synthetic accounts. Staging deployment must stop until the staging environment and participant-data handling rules are resolved. The SSO deferment must be reconciled in the canonical project records before launch planning.
